download_hf_file: download a file from the Hugging Face Hub to the local cache directory
build_hf_file_url: build a URL for a file hosted on the Hugging Face Hub given repo id and filename
fetch_file_metadata: fetch metadata such as etag, commit hash, and size for a file on the Hugging Face Hub
check_symlink_support: check whether symbolic links are supported in a given cache directory
load_from_cache: load a cached file from the local Hugging Face Hub cache by repo id and filename
